question: Ultraviolet - visible molecular absorption spectrometry involves the study of:

options.opa: The vibrational and rotational modes of tension and bending of the atoms of a molecule.
options.opb: Exclusively the rotational energy changes in the molecules.
options.opc: The scattering of radiation visible by the molecules.
options.opd: The electronic energy changes of the molecules, producing simultaneously vibrational and rotational transitions.
